review: 710.1c-1: the red-card swap was labelled does_not_fire, but it does not make 710.1c fail (a flip never changes color; the rule has no does_not_fire branch); relabelled it other as a control and trimmed its expected to the legality verdict.
710.1c-2: the Bushi Tenderfoot swap was labelled does_not_fire though 710.1c (mana cost unchanged by flipping) cannot fail; relabelled it other as a control.

710.1c-3: Glorious Anthem on A's vs B's side only tested 'creatures you control', and a static anthem applies regardless of any flip; rebuilt it so Giant Growth pumps the unflipped Nezumi Graverobber, which then flips through its own ability and is 7/5 as Nighteyes the Desecrator, with a no-pump control (polarity other, since 710.1c has no failing branch).

triage 710.1b/710.1c/710.2/710.5: a continuous or playability record shows name, types, P/T, color and the activation verdict as fields, so observability is direct rather than indirect/needs_new_fields; 710.5's record kind is playability (what its scenario observes) and 710.1c gains playability.

scenarios.title: A flipped permanent has the alternative name, type line, power, toughness and abilities

setup.notes: Akki Lavarunner starts unflipped. Wall of Wood is on B's battlefield in the base setup so that the variant only changes the block declaration.

decisions: A declares Akki Lavarunner (1/1 haste) as an attacker against B.
Combat damage is dealt; Akki Lavarunner's trigger (whenever it deals damage to an opponent, flip it) goes on the stack and both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Akki Lavarunner deals 1 damage to B (B at 19) and its trigger flips it. The permanent is now named Tok-Tok, Volcano Born, is a legendary Goblin Shaman creature that is 2/2 with protection from red, and no longer has haste.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares Wall of Wood (0/3) as a blocker of Akki Lavarunner.
variants.expected: Akki Lavarunner deals 1 damage to Wall of Wood (1 damage marked) and none to B (B at 20); the flip trigger does not fire. The permanent is still Akki Lavarunner, a nonlegendary 1/1 Goblin Warrior with haste.

scenarios.forge_notes: Flip cards are the two-faced Forge scripts with AlternateMode:Flip; the alternate face is Tok-Tok, Volcano Born.

scenarios.title: A flipped permanent keeps its color

setup.notes: B's Nezumi Graverobber is flipped (Nighteyes the Desecrator, a black creature).

decisions: A considers casting Doom Blade (destroy target nonblack creature), paying with both Swamps, targeting B's flipped permanent.

variants.label: flipped_black
variants.expected: Doom Blade has no legal target: the flipped permanent Nighteyes the Desecrator is still black, so it is not a legal target.

variants.label: flipped_red
variants.delta: B's flipped permanent is Akki Lavarunner (flipped, Tok-Tok, Volcano Born, a red creature) instead of Nezumi Graverobber.
variants.expected: Doom Blade has a legal target: the flipped permanent Tok-Tok, Volcano Born is red, so casting Doom Blade targeting it is legal.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the second variant Tok-Tok's protection from red does not stop Doom Blade, which is black.

scenarios.title: A flipped permanent keeps its mana cost and mana value

setup.notes: B's Akki Lavarunner (mana cost {3}{R}, mana value 4) is flipped (Tok-Tok, Volcano Born).

decisions: A considers casting Smother (destroy target creature with mana value 3 or less), paying with both Swamps, targeting B's flipped permanent.

variants.label: flipped_mv4
variants.expected: Smother has no legal target: the flipped permanent still has the mana cost {3}{R}, mana value 4.

variants.label: flipped_mv1
variants.delta: B's flipped permanent is Bushi Tenderfoot (flipped, Kenzo the Hardhearted, mana cost {W}) instead of Akki Lavarunner.
variants.expected: Smother has a legal target: the flipped permanent has mana value 1, so casting it is legal.

scenarios.title: An external effect applied before the flip still applies after it

setup.notes: A's Nezumi Graverobber starts unflipped (2/1). Grizzly Bears is the only card in B's graveyard.

decisions: A casts Giant Growth targeting Nezumi Graverobber, tapping Forest. Both players pass; it resolves.

A activates Nezumi Graverobber's ability ({1}{B}: exile target card from an opponent's graveyard; if no cards are in that graveyard, flip it), tapping both Swamps, targeting Grizzly Bears in B's graveyard. Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: pumped_then_flipped
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is exiled and Nezumi Graverobber flips into Nighteyes the Desecrator, which is 7/5: its 4/2 plus Giant Growth's +3/+3.

variants.label: not_pumped
variants.delta: A does not cast Giant Growth.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is exiled and Nezumi Graverobber flips into Nighteyes the Desecrator, which is 4/2.

scenarios.title: Only the alternative characteristics apply once flipped, only the normal ones before

setup.notes: A's Akki Lavarunner is flipped (Tok-Tok, Volcano Born, a legendary creature).

decisions: No actions are taken; the board is observed in A's first main phase.

variants.label: flipped
variants.expected: The flipped permanent is legendary Tok-Tok, Volcano Born, so Day of Destiny (legendary creatures you control get +2/+2) applies: it is 4/4 with protection from red.

variants.label: unflipped
variants.expected: The permanent is the nonlegendary Akki Lavarunner, so Day of Destiny does not apply: it is 1/1 with haste.

scenarios.title: A flipped permanent that leaves the battlefield returns unflipped

setup.notes: A's Nezumi Graverobber on the battlefield is flipped (Nighteyes the Desecrator, 4/2).

decisions: A casts Unsummon targeting their own flipped permanent, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Unsummon resolves and the card returns to A's hand.
A casts Nezumi Graverobber from hand, tapping both Swamps. Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: bounced_and_recast
variants.expected: The recast permanent is unflipped: Nezumi Graverobber, a nonlegendary 2/1 Rat Rogue with its exile ability. It kept no memory of being flipped.

variants.label: not_bounced
variants.delta: A casts neither Unsummon nor Nezumi Graverobber; no actions are taken.
variants.expected: The permanent stays on the battlefield and stays flipped: Nighteyes the Desecrator, a legendary 4/2.

scenarios.title: A flip card's alternative name can be chosen as a card name and matches the flipped permanent

setup.notes: A's Nezumi Graverobber is flipped (Nighteyes the Desecrator). Pithing Needle entered with the chosen card name Nighteyes the Desecrator.

decisions: A considers activating the flipped permanent's ability ({4}{B}: put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control), paying with the five Swamps and targeting Grizzly Bears in A's graveyard.

variants.label: alt_name_chosen
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: Pithing Needle's chosen name matches the flipped permanent's alternative name, so its activated ability can't be activated.

variants.label: other_name_chosen
variants.delta: Pithing Needle's chosen card name is Nezumi Graverobber instead.
variants.expected: The activation is legal: the flipped permanent is named Nighteyes the Desecrator, which doesn't match the chosen name, so it can be activated targeting Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's NameCard choice may only offer the front-face name of a flip card; if the alternative name cannot be chosen in the game, this scenario cannot be played directly.
